title: Basic rules
subtitle: tables, anchors, keep state and block drop

cmds:
cat > /tmp/demo.conf <<'EOF'
set block-policy return
table <trusted> { 10.0.1.0/24 }
anchor "demo"
pass in quick on ingress proto icmp from <trusted> keep state
pass out quick on egress proto icmp keep state
pass in quick
pass out quick
EOF

cat > /tmp/block.conf <<'EOF'
set block-policy return
block drop in quick on ingress proto icmp from 10.0.1.0/24
pass in quick
pass out quick
EOF

cat > /tmp/anchor.conf <<'EOF'
pass in quick on ingress proto icmp from 10.0.1.10 to 10.0.2.20 keep state
pass in quick
pass out quick
EOF
